ops.title: wn sqlite connection crosses threads in signals/nlp.py lemmas()
ops.description: capt-hookd.log shows sqlite3.ProgrammingError ('SQLite objects created in a thread can only be used in that same thread', thread ids differ) from captain_hook/signals/nlp.py:74 lemmas() → RESOURCES.wn.synsets(): the cached wn.Wordnet/sqlite connection in captain_hook.state.NlpResources is created on one worker thread and used from another. Signal-scored hooks relying on WordNet lemmas fail when evaluation moves threads. Make the wn connection per-thread (threading.local) or confine NLP scoring to one thread.

ops.text: lemmas() works when called from a thread other than the one that first touched RESOURCES.wn (regression test)
